# momento_valkey_database (Resource)

A Valkey Database.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "momento_valkey_database" "example" {
  name      = "database-name"
  pool_name = momento_capacity_pool.example.name
  metrics_config = {
    cloud_watch = {
      iam_role_arn = local.metrics_iam_role
      region       = "us-east-1"
    }
  }
}

resource "momento_capacity_pool" "example" {
  name = "flex-pool-name"
  provisioning = {
    flex = {
      capacity = {
        max_gib = 25,
        min_gib = 20
      },
      replication = {
        max_replicas_per_shard = 1,
        min_replicas_per_shard = 0
      },
      zones = [
        "usw2-az1",
        "usw2-az2"
      ]
    }
  }
}

locals {
  metrics_iam_role = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/MomentoMetricsRole"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the Valkey Database.
- `pool_name` (String) The name of the Capacity Pool that this Database is pinned to.

### Optional

- `metrics_config` (Attributes) Optional configuration for exporting CloudWatch metrics. When omitted, the Database inherits its Pool's metrics config. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics_config))

<a id="nestedatt--metrics_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metrics_config`

Optional:

- `cloud_watch` (Attributes) Deliver this Database's metrics to your CloudWatch account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics_config--cloud_watch))
- `disabled` (Boolean) Disable delivery of this Database's metrics to your CloudWatch account.

<a id="nestedatt--metrics_config--cloud_watch"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metrics_config.cloud_watch`

Required:

- `iam_role_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM role that Momento will assume to export metrics.

Optional:

- `region` (String) The AWS region where the metrics will be exported to. When omitted, defaults to the region this Database runs in.
